facts.fact: A World Bank-backed parametric crop insurance scheme, whose contract is held by the Congolese Ministry of Agriculture and which uses satellite-derived rainfall data to trigger payouts, has been running in Kasai-Central since January 2025 and began paying compensation on 14 October 2026.
Ecofin Agency reports the scheme's first compensation payments went to 17,180 smallholder farmers in Kasai-Central, with a pilot aiming to cover up to 300,000 farmers through September 2027.

systems.owner: Ministry of Agriculture (PNDA), with World Bank, AXA Climate, Mayfair Insurance Congo
